🚨BREAKING: The Republican Women’s Caucus Fund has been unmasked as the force behind the fake Texas Transgender Student Union (TTSU). This Wyoming LLC, formed in September, flooded as many as 3 million Texas mailboxes and phones with texts and brochures just as early voting began for the midterms.

Posing as a trans advocacy outfit, the materials—addressed to the children of registered voters—coached minors on seeking gender-affirming care even against parents’ wishes, pursuing emancipation, going out-of-state for hormones or surgery, and finding a “found family.” They copied branding from the real Transgender Education Network of Texas (TENT) and used a near-identical address.

Legal filings named the Republican Women’s Caucus and “John Braun”—the name of a Washington state senator whose campaign treasurer, Paul Kilgore, also handles finances for the RWC Fund and PACs supporting Ken Paxton’s Senate bid against Democrat James Talarico. TTSU’s lawyer is former Paxton assistant AG Chris Hilton.

TENT sued, claiming harassment, threats, and operational harm. Judge Jan Soifer ordered disclosure, rejecting free-speech secrecy claims.

So, a Republican-linked group, with financial ties to Paxton-supporting PACs, mass-produced and distributed materials that impersonated a transgender student resource guide. In other words, the people who routinely accuse the transgender community of “indoctrinating” or targeting children, themselves produced and mailed the very content designed to look like that targeting—so parents would see it and react.

Every Republican accusation is a confession.

items.tx:
Israeli hostage survivor Bar Kupershtein, 24, has revealed the horrific torture, starvation and psychological abuse he endured during 738 days in Hamas captivity, including being forced to dig his own grave for a propaganda video, suffering repeated beatings and losing 65 pounds (29 kg).

Kupershtein described spending most of his captivity underground with five other hostages, without daylight, proper sanitation or sufficient food.

The hostages slept on thin mattresses on the floor, dug a hole beside them to use as a toilet and were allowed to shower only once a month. Their drinking water was contaminated, while meals consisted of rice and half a pita bread with cheese, infested with maggots.

Kupershtein recalled how Hamas terrorists repeatedly told the hostages that Israel had abandoned them and wanted them dead. They were also forced to record propaganda videos praising their captors.

Following the collapse of hostage negotiations in early 2025, the abuse intensified.
"Hamas came day after day and beat us," he recalled.

During one particularly brutal assault, terrorists blindfolded Kupershtein and fellow hostage Yosef Chaim Ohana, struck him in the face, dragged him by his leg into another room and tied his legs together.

He feared they were preparing to amputate one of his legs. The beating lasted approximately 30 minutes and left him unable to stand properly for a month.

Kupershtein had been working as a security guard at the Nova music festival on October 7, 2023, when Hamas launched its massacre.

Before being kidnapped, he convinced a police commander to open an emergency exit, helping more than 2,000 festivalgoers escape. He also used an all-terrain vehicle to evacuate injured people before terrorists overran the festival.

He was eventually captured and taken into Gaza.

Despite the horrific conditions, Kupershtein said he and his fellow hostages maintained their Jewish traditions, gathering every week for Kiddush prayers using salty water instead of wine.

On October 13, 2025, after 738 days in captivity, Kupershtein was released alongside 19 other surviving hostages.

His reunion with his family was especially emotional. His father, who had lost the ability to walk following a motorcycle accident in 2019, managed to stand to welcome him home.

A year later, Kupershtein says he has learned to appreciate the simplest freedoms, including opening his refrigerator, eating whenever he wants and taking a shower.

He has since traveled internationally to share his testimony, met US President Donald Trump at the White House and published his memoir, Unbreakable.

THE MOST INCOMPETENT WAR IN HISTORY: SARAH PAINE ON TRUMP’S IRAN DISASTER

Dr. Sarah Paine, a leading historian of great-power conflict and strategy, delivers a blunt verdict on the Iran war. She calls it one of the most incompetent wars in human history. The decision ignored basic principles of assessment, put maximum costs on America itself, and left permanent damage to the country’s power and alliances. This is not hindsight—it is the predictable result of hubris meeting reality.

THE CORE VERDICT
➡️ “The Iran war is probably one of the most incompetent wars in human history.”
➡️ A competent war puts the costs on the enemy and minimizes them for yourself.
➡️ This one did the opposite.

THE COST CATASTROPHE
➡️ It trashed the US economy.
➡️ It blew the US alliance system.
➡️ Iran is hurting, but the collateral damage is taking down the world’s economy.
➡️ That transforms the United States from a partner into an annoyance—and for many, a primary adversary—because it is threatening their economies.
➡️ “That’s breathtakingly incompetent.”

THE STRATEGIC BLIND SPOT
➡️ Any serious assessment looks at the enemy’s strengths and your own weaknesses, plus everyone else who might intervene.
➡️ That was absent.
➡️ The first thing Iran would do is shut Hormuz. Narrow seas close in wartime. Ukraine already showed this with the Black Sea.
➡️ Shore artillery, mines, and other tools stop traffic. There is no mystery here.
➡️ The big naval base in Bahrain becomes unreachable. The fallback is Diego Garcia, 2,500 miles away in the middle of nowhere. “That would be a mess.”

THE HUBRIS THAT MADE IT POSSIBLE
➡️ The people making the calls are historically unqualified for the job. That makes them profoundly dangerous.
➡️ Type A hubris assumes all decisions that matter happen in the United States.
➡️ Type B hubris assumes being good at one thing makes you good at everything.
➡️ Half-court tennis: you only watch your own side and never study the other team.
➡️ The Iranians understand Americans far better than Americans understand them.

THE UNFEASIBLE OBJECTIVE
➡️ Trying to “solve” Iran with 90 million people was never realistic.
➡️ Nazi Germany had roughly 80 million and required an occupation force of about 1.5 million just to hold it after the war—before counting everyone else.
➡️ The goal was unattainable. Pursuing it guarantees overextension and a bad ending.
➡️ The lesson the world takes is simple: get a nuke. The war incentivized proliferation.
➡️ This was a pivotal error. The choices that existed before are gone and will not return. “We will never be the trusted partner ever again. It’s done.”

THE BOTTOM LINE
The Iran war did not merely fail. It maximized American costs, destroyed trust with allies, and handed every rival a clearer reason to treat the United States as a threat to their own prosperity. Competence would have contained the problem at affordable cost. Hubris chose the opposite.

This is what permanent strategic damage looks like.

items.tx:
The World Bank’s October 2026 Poverty & Equity Brief records India’s progress as one of the fastest poverty declines in the world.
The report highlights several significant gains:

✅ 49.6 crore people moved above the lower-middle-income poverty line of $4.20 a day between 2011 and 2023, with the poverty rate declining from 57.7% to 16.1%.

✅ Extreme poverty declined from 27.1% to 2.6% over the same period, measured at $3 a day. Both monetary poverty thresholds use 2021 purchasing power parity.

✅ Employment increased by 13.4 crore people between 2017 and 2023, nearly twice the increase in the working-age population.

✅ Rural women accounted for much of the employment gain, entering paid work and increasing the number of earners in their households.

✅ Both rural and urban households experienced substantial welfare gains, with faster progress in rural India narrowing the rural–urban gap.

✅ Access to electricity reached 99% of the population, according to the report’s 2022 survey data.

The World Bank identifies strong consumption growth, rising employment - especially among women—and expanded social transfers, including food subsidies, as major drivers.

Under the leadership of Hon’ble PM Shri @narendramodi, the Government’s sustained policy efforts are yielding tangible results, strengthening the foundations for inclusive growth and greater economic opportunity. This is the reason why NDA govt wins people’s trust and mandate of our citizens.

We remain committed to building on this progress through productive employment, stronger household incomes and effective delivery of public services, so that aspirations of our people are met.

items.tx:
The Leader of the Opposition, @RahulGandhi, has raised the issue of the dodgy sale of IDBI Bank. For anyone who needs a refresher on the IDBI Bank sale - which smacks of crony capitalism-read on.

▪️IDBI Bank was sold to Canada-based Fairfax Financial Holdings for Rs 52,878 crore at Rs 81 per share

▪️The sale happened after rules were changed mid-process and at a much lower price than the original reserve price of ₹94.42, which was discarded

▪️Initial sealed bids from Fairfax and another entity were below the minimum reserve price of Rs 94.42. Fairfax bids came at Rs 75

▪️Core Group of Secretaries on Disinvestment changed valuation method, asked Fairfax and another bidder to give new bids

▪️Fairfax revised bid to Rs 81 per share, still well below the original reserve price of Rs 94.42

▪️Modi govt accepted it and also gave some relief on disputed tax claims on IDBI Bank

▪️In January 2019, LIC infused Rs 21,624 crore in IDBI when the bank was placed under the RBI’s strict Prompt Corrective Action framework

▪️LIC’s investment was at an average of ~₹61 per share to acquire a 51% controlling stake

▪️Later that year, LIC pumped in another ₹4,743 crore

▪️LIC’s investment required a special exemption from IRDAI, because normal rules cap an insurer’s stake in a listed company at 15%

▪️Over ₹26,000 crore of policyholders’ savings was used and locked up for years to clean the balance sheet and rescue IDBI Bank, only so that it could be stealthily sold
 
▪️The govt and LIC have been reduced to minority holders with no board seats

▪️Modi Govt’s internal note says this sale was necessary because the govt is under fiscal stress due to high energy prices, lack of FDI inflows and the falling Rupee

▪️The justification for the change of rules and methodology was made by citing General Financial Rules for the sale of government physical assets (not shares)

▪️It cited the Railway Stores Code on auctioning scrap: "Bids lower than the reserve prices may, however, be accepted by the Depot Officer where found expedient provided the Depot Officer doing so records his reasons in writing."

▪️IDBI Bank’s Gross NPA was at 31.78% in September 2018. The bank posted losses for 13 consecutive quarters accumulating to about ₹41,800 crore

▪️IDBI Bank entered RBI’s PCA in May 2017 and exited PCA on 10 March 2021 after the December 2020 results showed a turnaround 

▪️IDBI Bank’s 
 FY25 profit: ₹7,515 crore
 FY26 profit: ₹9,513 crore• 
Total business crossed ₹6.27 lakh crore by September 2026 

▪️▪️But the questions that remain unanswered:

🔺Why did the govt change the bidding rules after shortlisting and opening sealed bids, without starting the process from scratch?

🔺New bidders might have wanted to participate under the changed rules, why were they denied a chance?

🔺Why was the second bidder’s identity kept hidden on national-security grounds? 

🔺Why should policyholders’ savings be used to clean up assets which are then monetised and made to appear like a distress exit than a transparent market sale?

🔺Finally, why must a bank which has turned profitable be sold at much lower valuation - actually sold at all?

▪️▪️The IDBI sale proves yet again that public and policyholder money absorbs the losses, revives the asset which is then cleaned up and sold without transparency to a bidder of govt’s choice - keeping norms at bay and changing rules midway. It also raises the important question of why must an asset which has turned profitable be sold, especially at lower valuation?

Source: BusinessWorld’s investigative report by Palak Shah

Lie 2: "Why controlling stake? Why not minority/tranches?"
Because no one buys minority in a bank you can't control. IDBI is already classified as PRIVATE BANK since 2019 (after LIC took 51%). Govt decided in 2021 to exit fully. Strategic buyer needs 51%+ to get RBI license, to bring management, capital. Selling 5% via OFS every year is Congress style disinvestment - and IDBI share was Rs 40 in 2020. items.tx:
Every time I see one of these posts I am reminded of my favorite joke that always goes over with the bros, something like

two men are sitting in a diner, one in his 20s and the other in his 70s. The older man can tell the younger man is really upset and asks "are you ok son? You seem to be having a real tough time" and the younger man says "well, I just got off the phone with my girlfriend. We've been together for a few years now and she's really putting the pressure on about wanting to get married and start a family, but my folks got divorced when I was a kid and marriage just seems so scary to me. But I love her so much and I don't want to lose her. Are you married sir?" and the older man says "I am, in fact my wife and I recently celebrated our 50th anniversary." 

So the younger man says "that's amazing, I'd love that to be us. Do you mind me asking how did you know she was THE ONE?"

The older man tells him "its actually a funny story, when I was your age I was a bit of a playboy, always going out with different women every night and it was pretty routine for me to have 2 or 3 steady girlfriends at a time. But a lot of my friends were settling down and starting families and I started thinking about how I wanted that for myself. The problem was I was seeing 3 different women at the time, and every one of them was someone I could really see building a life and a future with. All 3 were smart and funny and beautiful and I always had a great time with each of them. So I decided I'd give each one $100, that was a lot of money back then!, and tell them to do whatever they wanted with it and I figured I'd get a good idea of what kind of wife and mother they would be by how they spent it. 

So I gave the first girl I had been seeing the money and told her to do whatever she wanted and she said "well I tell you what I'm going to do with it, I'm going to go to the beauty parlor and get all done up, buy a new dress, and take you out on the town tonight. We'll go to your favorite restaurant and then out to a nightclub and you can make all the other fellas jealous!" And she really did look like a movie star, I was so proud to be seen with her on my arm and I thought what a fun time we would have as a couple. 

Well then the next day I see the second woman I'd been seeing and tell her the same thing, and she thinks for a minute and says "well, I'd hate to spend all that money on myself. If its ok I'd like to give it to my brother, you know he and his family have really been going through some hard times. He was in that awful car wreck and had to be in the hospital for weeks. They've got a lot of bills piled up from that and this would really help him and his wife out so much, is it ok if I give to them?" and I thought what a kind and generous person she was, if she was that thoughtful to her brother and his family how much more would she be with ours.

Well then I see the third woman, and I give her the money and tell her the same thing. She thinks for a bit and says "I'm going to take this down to the bank and buy a savings bond with it. I don't really need anything right now but you never know what the future holds and it would be a good idea for us to start thinking about the future, this would be a good way to start." And I thought what a smart and practical woman, she'd make such a fantastic wife and mother, someone I know I could trust to make good decisions for our family."

The young man looks at him and says "wow, all that must have made it an even tougher decision. How did you decide?"

And the older man says "I picked the one with the biggest boobs."
